info.name: INT HR Platform API - Complete Server Functions Collection
info.description: Complete and exhaustive Postman collection for the INT HR Management System (TanStack Start server functions & Supabase Edge Functions). Includes full request schemas, input payloads, authentication tokens, and headers for Employees, Geofencing, Biometrics, Attendance, Leaves, Advances/Solaf, Permissions, Contracts, Custody, KPIs, Tasks, Trips, Payroll, and Security.

variable.description: Application host (local dev server or production deployment)
Supabase project REST and Auth base URL
Authenticated user JWT access token passed in Authorization: Bearer header

request.description: Authenticate directly with Supabase Auth using email and password to receive access_token and refresh_token.
Refresh expired session JWT using refresh token.
Fetches the current authenticated user profile, employee code, active status, and primary role.
Fetches detailed employee profile, company department, job position, city, and settings.
Assigns an administrative or functional role (admin, hr, manager, finance, employee) to a user.

Retrieves the security audit log of all role elevation and assignment changes.
